info.title: INSEET CRM API
info.description: Use from your CRM server. Store X-API-Key as a server-side secret. No bulk delete or provider-secret endpoints. updatedSince returns modified records, not deleted-record tombstones. Admin accounts cannot be mutated through integration keys. Branding updates merge with saved settings. Request history is retained without automatic expiry. Keys can remain valid until revoked.
